reason: The report controls for the pre-treatment confounders (firm size, age, baseline patents), and the raw positive association (+1.6) disappears once they are included. The null result holds without trimming (-0.28, p=0.24), with extra pre-period covariates, and with quadratic or subgroup terms. The post-treatment collaboration index was correctly left out. The CI of about -0.75 to 0.19 is small relative to the outcome SD of 10.9, so 'no detectable effect' is supported.
